scope: Las Vegas only, current track branch, no worktrees. Existing user changes remain outside the commit.
state: Complete after Luna High review of the barrier/curb/trackside follow-up, full live lap and final packaged views.

references.map: 2025 FIA Event Notes Circuit Map V2, issued 2025-11-19
references.onboard: User-supplied Vegas.mp4; dry night footage. Local review frames are ignored build output.
references.limits: The map establishes turn order, not runoff dimensions. Escape widths/lengths, roof sag and facade details are original visual reconstructions registered to mapped streets and building footprints; no engineering survey or scanned architecture is claimed. No reference-image pixels are shipped.

geometry.root_cause: Dense sampling preserved angular street controls, while heading-based widths and averaged normals introduced edge direction changes. Generic shoulders did not represent straight escape roads.
geometry.correction: Filter source XY before interpolation; use local geometric normals and independently controlled quintic widths. Harmon short reversals use a smaller filter.

protection.method: A single paved union supplies visible floor, native driving contact and closed collision boundaries. Extra paving remains outside white-line timing limits. Terrain is clipped to that same union.
protection.sphere_apron: Localized blue asphalt outside/right of the chicane; unsupported inside entry wedge removed. Extent is deliberately bounded because its far edge is cropped in the reference.
protection.ends: Open escape mouths and closed tire-protected far ends.
protection.joins: Shared mitered wall, panel and fence corners; visible endpoint-height lofts and native vertical envelopes.

changes: Removed roadside hotel name boards; names attach to actual facades or the Paris balloon.
Wynn and Encore use curved bronze curtain glazing, dipped roof lines, horizontal illuminated bands and lettering conformed to the facade.
Palazzo, Venetian and Bellagio retain mapped wings, stone bays and crowns; low podiums use shop glazing and arcades.
Paris has roof dormers and a rounded blue balloon with gold ribs and legs.
Horseshoe casino footprint corrected to a low podium; the separate mapped southern tower is retained.
Marshal posts, markers, lamps, stands and palms account for the real paved areas.
Right-side barrier panel lettering corrected to face the road without mirrored UVs.
Veer Towers East and West rebuilt with opposing 5 degree leans, staggered yellow/clear glazing, horizontal louvers and tall glazed lobbies.
Crystals roof peak separated from the low glazed shopfront body, with reconstructed faceted metal/glass roof shards. Adjacent Arte Museum frontage uses modern retail glazing.
Reference-based curb extensions on the Sphere approach and outside Harmon braking approach, shallow beveled curb faces and metre-aligned red/white stripes.
Blue/black wall treatment on the Sphere approach, mapped Wynn open-deck parking facade, closer Strip palms excluded from building footprints.
Removed oversized freestanding street/Sphere label boards. Track-spanning race gantries remain.
scenery.limits: Simplified original architecture in the existing game style. Smaller city filler remains simplified; this is not a complete photogrammetric city.

performance.platform: Linux Vulkan SM5, Intel Iris Xe, Unreal 5.8.3
performance.window: CSV frames 500-1399 of 1400, all 900 sampled frames with active live simulation. Serial representative long-straight runs; not a full-lap uncapped profile.
performance.note: Vegas rerun after the final barrier/curb/planting changes. Accepted Monza/Interlagos runs retain equal settings and unchanged assets; they were measured earlier in this session.

preserved: Accepted circuit assets, vehicle handling, speed, shifting and camera are unchanged. Vegas-only ground lookup now follows the escape-road contact mesh.

live_lap.method: Existing Vegas audit controller drives the real native simulation at 0.60 pace. Finite lap, keyboard input, pause/resume, restart, results and menu return run in one Unreal process.
live_lap.subsequent_change: Only foliage geometry/placement changed after this lap. Barrier/contact/curb data, road geometry, vehicle and camera are identical. Final Strip still and uncapped performance run cover the final foliage.

memory.window: Final serial guarded barrier/curb validation jobs from 2026-11-06 09:00 UTC onward

root_causes: Floating-point boundary classification alternated between street and escape-road heights.
Flat per-segment wall prisms inherited those height jumps.
Fence overhang and sign faces used independently offset segment ends, leaving gaps at sharp junctions.

after.method: Tolerance-aware deck selection, baked endpoint heights, sloped wall/fence lofts and shared mitered junctions. Native wall bottom/top encloses both endpoint heights.

barrier_followup.checks: 11 focused tests passed, including barrier endpoint continuity/native vertical coverage and shared fence edges in the serialized render mesh. Native checks and full live session flow passed.
barrier_followup.preserved: Road centreline, widths, handling, speed, shifting and camera.

reviewer.finding: No visible barrier/fence height steps, detached panels or corner gaps in the reviewed moving/cockpit views. Curb placement and final Strip palms cleared.

supplemental_escape_view.method: Explicitly presentation-only fixed replay pose inside the escape road. Visual evidence only; physics and session evidence come from the separate live full lap.

barrier_followup.planting_note: An intermediate simple canopy-tree model was removed before the final package; the final scene uses the existing detailed palm geometry.
